Method of Attack: Stealing personal data including logon credentials, tax records, medical records, photographs, banking records, Internet searches, and communications
Spying on victims by secretly turning on the computer's microphone and webcam
Alerting the attacker when users typed words associated with pornography
Saving millions of images from victims' computers and keeping detailed notes
Using stolen credentials to access and download users' data from third-party websites
Attack Vector: Malware infection on Mac systems, including via university computer systems
Indicators of Compromise: Presence on Case Western Reserve University computer systems
